assumptions.statement: The supplied overall and key-area polygons are provisional clipping envelopes, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All design layers, positions and denominator-based metrics must be rebound and recalculated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, roads, ownership, utilities, fire requirements and georeferenced heritage-control boundaries/drawings are not available; general heritage status and text context are available.
assumptions.impact: Statutory metrics remain unknown and no approval or development right is claimed; official control drawings and authority overlay remain mandatory.

assumptions.statement: Three normalised architectural reference cells are placed near provisional key-area centroids.
assumptions.impact: They test spatial relationships and are not parcel-specific designs.

assumptions.statement: NASA POWER monthly values remain a coarse climate seed; the separate direct-sun study uses the provisional geometry centroid, NREL SPA, typed 4.2 m roofs, seasonally deployed cassettes and hypothetical tree-crown states.
assumptions.impact: Results support geometric massing sensitivity only, not statutory insolation, daylight, energy, wind, drainage, UTCI/MRT, structural or operating compliance.

assumptions.statement: Reference grids, heights and sections have not undergone local structure, fire, egress, MEP or geotechnical design.
assumptions.impact: All life-safety and construction decisions require qualified local professionals.

assumptions.statement: Every AI service uses an A/B/H City Task Contract: incumbent A and candidate B keep the same task and declared data/tool/authority scope; permanent H remains selectable; two independent stewards are required; critical regressions deny by default and roll back.
assumptions.impact: The deterministic verifier proves design-time wiring only. No live model, user, field trial, deployment, public release or government operating commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: The shared-floor widths are target envelopes that compress according to surveyed conditions.
assumptions.impact: Step-free walking, emergency access and drainage outrank robot service where width is insufficient.

assumptions.statement: Seven transverse lines are interface test positions; station exits, traffic flows and road redlines are unverified.
assumptions.impact: Detailed alignment waits for station, street, accessibility and seven-day movement surveys.

assumptions.statement: Rain gardens and temporary storage are spatial reservations without hydraulic sizing.
assumptions.impact: Depth, volume, overflow and pipes require topography, soil, groundwater and municipal drainage data.

assumptions.statement: The 100+ / 100 / 25–40 / 5–20 / ≤5-year bands are participant-authored value-retention and replacement-cycle targets for public ground, support, service chassis, infill and AI equipment.
assumptions.impact: They organise phasing and detailing but are not certified service lives; survey, system selection and local engineering may revise them.

assumptions.statement: The terms jian, yuan, xiang, lang and threshold describe contemporary modular, civic and climatic spatial operations rather than a reconstruction of historical form.
assumptions.impact: No pseudo-historical silhouette, material claim or borrowed view is authorised without site and heritage evidence.

assumptions.statement: District statistics and Beijing studies frame user groups but do not establish flows, income, disability, gate access, safety perception or operating demand within the project boundary.
assumptions.impact: Fifteen social rehearsals remain hypotheses until seven-day observation, accompanied route walks, gate audit and operator/community interviews are completed.

assumptions.statement: Operated, timed campus access opens only selected public-side routes at agreed times and under emergency rules; it does not imply unrestricted access to campuses or residential compounds.
assumptions.impact: Each access point requires owner, university, community, security, emergency and accessibility agreement before implementation.

assumptions.statement: The Dazhongsi overlay uses the midpoint of two OSM station records as a non-authoritative anchor. A literal station-centred 148 m reference frame is rejected; one 36 m test-fit envelope at +114 m east / -12 m north contains only an 8 m covered bay and 16 m reversible ground patch.
assumptions.impact: This is geometry-only non-intersection, not site selection, vacancy, title, buildability or permission. Official redline, ownership, metro protection, surveyed accessibility, utilities, geotechnics, fire and operator evidence can discard or rebind the patch.

assumptions.statement: Five regional coordination interfaces remain concepts pending confirmation by counterpart institutions.
assumptions.impact: No regional flow, schedule, resource or programme is represented as an agreed collaboration.

assumptions.statement: Current changeover results verify contract, fixture, permanent-H, two-key and rollback wiring only; field completion, burden, incidents, non-inferiority and recovery time remain unmeasured.
assumptions.impact: No design-time receipt may be presented as field performance; authorised pilots require preregistered baselines and stop rules.

assumptions.statement: Renewal-package scales, actor types and funding classes are participant-authored planning envelopes informed by geometry and public context, not quantities derived from source data.
assumptions.impact: They organise dependencies and stop conditions but are not estimates, procurement packages, assignments or institutional commitments.
